segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Budget briefing on the fiscal year 2027, proposed budget by the my most beloved agency, Technical Education and Skills Development Authority, or TESDA.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Now, hereby called to order, we would like to acknowledge the entire TESDA family headed by our good friend, former Commissioner of ETCOM, Secretary Kiko Benitez.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We would also acknowledge our DDGs. Hindi ko na ho kayo iisa-isahin. And of course, our friends from COA, the entire TESDA family. Magandang hapon po sa inyong lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So let me start by commending all of you for your service to our country and our people. Such a great honor and privilege.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Na naging part po ako ng TESDA. At hanggang ngayon, I go with the TESDA man moniker. At muli ho, magandang hapon sa inyong lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: TESDA has always held a special place in my heart bilang dating hepe ng TESDA. Personal po sa atin ang mission na bigyan ang bawat Pilipino ng kasanayan at pagkakataon na magkaroon ng marangal na trabaho at mas magandang buhay.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Mas magandang kinabukasan. Sa likod po ng bawat TESDA scholarship na very famous, very popular, ay isang kabataan na naghahanap ng kanyang unang trabaho.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Isa pong magulang na nagnanais madagdagan ang kita ng kanilang pamilya o isang manggagawang kailangan mag-upskill upang hindi po maiwan ng nagbabagong ekonomiya.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: In 2026, TESDA received its largest budget on record.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: But its current budget is only 2.2% of the total education budget. Laging sinasabi, ang TESDA ay partin ng tinatawag na trinity doon sa trifocalized education with the Department of Education and the Commission on Higher Education.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: At gaya ng trinity sa isang pananampalataya, yung TESDA daw yung tumatay yung Holy Spirit.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: For 2027, TESDA is proposing a budget of 21.20 billion, 5.15 billion or 19.5% lower than its 2026 budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Now, of this amount, 20.48 billion is intended for operations.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Direct program allocations include 19.66 billion for the Technical Education Skills Development Program.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: 497.6 million for the Regulatory Program and 40.1 million for the Policy Program.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Sa bawat isang daang piso sa panukala ng budget ng TESDA, halos 93 pesos ang nakalaan sa Core Technical Education and Skills Development Program,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: which covers scholarships, training, and other skills development interventions.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Now, with fewer resources and continuing demand for training,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: every peso must work harder and reach those who need it most.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: But a scholarship slot alone is not success.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: A TESDA scholarship must be a complete pathway from enrollment and quality training

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: to assessment, certification, and ultimately decent work for a sustainable livelihood.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ngayong pong araw, nais po nating malaman.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Nakakarating po ba ang mga scholarships sa mahihirap at underserved communities?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ang mga kursong pinupondohan ba natin ay talagang kailangan ng industriya? Nakapagtatapos nga po ba na-assess at nasa-certify ang ating mga scholar at ating mga kliyente? At nagkakaroon po ba sila ng trabaho angkop sa kanilang natututunan?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We also want TESDA scholarships to prepare Filipinos for the future through higher qualifications, micro-credentials, digital and AI skills, enterprise-based training, and clear pathways for continuous learning and career advancement.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: TESDA is seeking additional funding for more than 162,000 beneficiaries. And of course, as always, we are here ready to support resources that will genuinely expand opportunity.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: But expansion must be matched also by implementation capacity, transparency, timely fund utilization, and measurable employment outcomes. Our purpose is very clear.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We wanted to strengthen TESDA and its programs, but also ensure that every scholarship delivers on its promise to the Filipino people.

segments.text: obviously, we would like that to grow

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: ang gusto namin is up to supposedly 30 to 40%

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: of the total universe of test scholarships or EBET.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: and we're trying to move that up at least 18%.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Pero wala pa po kami doon in terms of the transition.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I really appreciate the questions raised by our Senate President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kasi looking at the funding, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Yung Tulong Trabaho Fund, which is, we started with 1 billion, now it's, if I'm not mistaken, 1.65 billion for 2027, as I saw it a while ago. Dito rin kinukuha yung EBET, diba? Am I right?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Yes, sir. Because at the moment, most of the demand for EBET has been in upskilling. Dito po nang gagaling ang tinitraining namin for the BPO industry for upskilling. Because they are employees that are looking for upskilling, if you remember.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Yes, yes, yes. I'm aware of that. It's just that for me, I think it should not be the only funding na pwede nating pagkuhanan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And in fact, I would suggest that we...

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We separate the SP from EBET. Para yung concerns ni SP, which I also agree. Sayang yung opportunity and we can focus on enterprise base in such a way that we'll be able to figure out how else we can work on it, improve.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And looking at the historical background of the financial program.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I think that in terms of TTSP, hindi naman nag-grow ng malaki eh. So kung doon lang yung universe mo eh, from...

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Ano po, nasa batas ho ninyo na pwede pong kumuha rin sa TWSP. So pwede pong TWSP at TTSP.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Exactly. That's why ako ang suggestion ko, I mean, at least look into it. Baka magandang ihiwalay-lagyan natin ang sariling item, yung EBET. Diba?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Pwede po. Para mas ano na.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Mas klaro. And they just gave me an idea when I was listening to our Senate President. Yeah, please, please, please continue.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And Secretary, meron bang... Kasi merong... I think it's also the number of enterprises that join. So I remember talking to you about this na I think one of the parang concern or one of the complication,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: there's a... At least dun sa na-experience ko, kailangan pa i-amend ng corporation ng kanilang Articles of Incorporation.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So, syempre sa kanila, parang hassle pa. Tapos, of course, kukuha ka pa ng abogado. So may mga ganun na maliliit na bagay. And also the claiming of incentives. I think this was also raised by EDCOM.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Overlook lang na agency na maliliit na bagay na sa atin maliit pero sa participating companies, hassle. Hassle sa kanila. Kaya huwag na lang. Huwag na tayo sumali dyan. So have you taken a look at this issue?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Yes, sir. And in fact, it's not just the amendment of the Articles of Incorporation to include education and training as a provision. It's also things like TESDA guidelines, sir, required a...

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Ano talaga ba dyan? Notarized contract, sir, between the EBET provider or the enterprise and the learner. So we've tried to review all those guidelines in order to streamline them.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: We are hoping to comply with the EBET provisions on a digital one-stop shop by the fourth quarter, sir, of this year. So we're hoping that many of those little issues in terms of implementation...

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: can be overcome before we launch the digital one-stop shop. I am assuming that even after we do so, may lalabas pa rin po yan na mahirap na kailangan ding palitan ng TESDA in terms of its internal rules and guidelines.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: But yes, sir, we understand that these are parts of the problem because the law, again, of Senator Joel...

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: It's TVI's from registering. So the enterprise has to take the lead in terms of its registration. And many of those enterprises actually are reluctant to create training plans and so on, would rather partner up as that kind of dual training system with an institution.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: But the institution cannot, in fact, like they used to before the institution could register and partner up with an enterprise for the...

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: enterprise-based portion. Ngayon po, baliktad. And the TVI institution, the TECVOC institution cannot be the one to register, even if they are on behalf of the enterprise, right?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Kung kahit na-partner sila, which is another one of those hurdles. But it is, sir, it's in the law.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kung ngayon, yung enterprise, they need to partner.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: But in many ways, that's probably the...

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Most practical for them to partner up with the TVI. But in fact, make the TVI help generate the training plan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And they can actually be part of the assessment program, di ba?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: The last na lang siguro is one of the things that we've been looking forward to aside from the one-stop shop.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: In fact, is to be able to finally fund the rollout of eBET integrators po, no?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Kasi wala po sa budget namin.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: EBET integrators po for small and micro enterprises that might not otherwise have the capacity to generate the training plans and so on needed, no?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Or have the size and scale.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Nasa batas nyo rin po yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Just given the, you know, yung three points that still pending, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Itong eBET support integrators, itong eBET one-stop shop, and itong eBET grievance mechanism still pending.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Ang eBET grievance mechanism, sir, internal to the enterprises, we require them to have one.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Wala pa yung guidelines on mechanism on addressing disputes.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So, we will come up with that also like in the next two weeks.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Bottom line lang, Secretary, is just take a look at the...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Those mga maliliit na bagay lang, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: These are things that we might have overlooked.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero nakaka-ano siya, nakaka-discouraged ng participants, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But this, in eBET is particularly, lahat naman tayo sinusuportahan ito, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Because we all know the outcome.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, I keep on saying your law, pero principal authors...

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Without your support and without the staff support of EDGOM, we would not be able to...

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We'll never be able to finish.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: This particular bill that became a law.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Anyway, thank you so much to our Senate President who is also a candidate for being Secretary of TESDA

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: because he knows very well how TESDA works, how everything works from the little things

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: and all these scholarship programs na very confusing sometimes.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Thank you very much again and we appreciate the presence of our Senate President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Just a few more questions, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Let me go to another topic that is very dear to me, itong lifelong learning.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Given that TESDA has a central role in TVET and skills development under this particular law

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: that we all supported, by the way, and as part of EDCOM, we are all espousing itong Lifelong Learning

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: May we know, in this year's budget, how much was programmed or identified for the initial implementation?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kasi ano yan eh, as of August 31, diba, part of the law, yung section 14, provides that initial implementation

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: shall be funded from the existing budgets of the concerned agencies, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Paano yung akikita natin na magiging part niyan?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Ang ginawa namin, sa totoo lang, as you know, kalalabas lang po ng IRR

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: at hindi pa po lumalabas ang master plan ng PQF National Coordinating Council.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: And in the absence of that, in terms of targeting lifelong learning efforts per se,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: what we have been doing has been using our current budgets for things like creative industries, right?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: For things that may not look like they are directly related to employment per se,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: but might be for culture, for heritage.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: All of that, sir, is going to be part of the lifelong learning rollout, particularly for LGUs,

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: which is also, after all, part of the proposal to get DILG to spearhead its implementation.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So sa ngayon, sir, yun pa lang ang aming mga nilalagay or ginagawa.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Wala pa pong identified line item that says this is lifelong learning.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I was about to say that.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I'm happy to note that the Secretary of TESDA is now the chairperson of the PQF National Referencing Committee.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Sir, referencing committee po kami, hindi po kami sa lifelong learning.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Yeah, but considering that you are there, nasa kanila yung bola, at least maano natin yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And of course, that brings me to my next point, how much allocated for 2026 and for 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kasi laki nung responsibility na binibigay sa TESDA's work under the Philippine Qualifications Framework

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Sir, ang budget po niyan nasa DepEd. Wala po sa TESDA.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Wala po. Walang specific po for the PQF work.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We can get a line item for that?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Pwede naman, sir. Kaya lang. Sa totoo lang, may unused pa po sa DepEd eh.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: The budget is actually at DepEd and they haven't actually used it yet.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So ililipat na lang namin, sir.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Pero sila po ang chair ng PQF Council.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I know, I know. I'm just kidding.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: At saka si Senator Angare is more than capable of bringing reforms.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Anyway, when we test the complete…

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We can submit itong Philippines Updated AQRF, yung re-referencing report to the ASEAN Qualifications Referencing Framework Committee.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And perhaps the next question would be what remaining steps must be completed before the endorsement and the publication ito?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Sir, it's ongoing and there is in fact…

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Namimiss ka na rin, namimiss na rin ni SPWin yung boses mo.

segments.speaker: TESDA Deputy Director General Rosanna Urdaneta
segments.text: The last AQRF was held in Bangkok, Thailand a month ago.

segments.speaker: TESDA Deputy Director General Rosanna Urdaneta
segments.text: And we have promised that we have committed that we shall submit the updated report on December.

segments.speaker: TESDA Deputy Director General Rosanna Urdaneta
TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: Sorry, Mr. Chair, if I may line just to be even more specific.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: The request of the ASEAN Qualifications Referencing Framework has been for us to do an update of our report rather than to re-reference because of the number of reforms, no?

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: That we have undertaken that was not part of the original…

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: So, at this point, what the committee is doing is, in fact, updating the original referencing report to include the new level descriptors and so on and so forth.

segments.speaker: TESDA Secretary Jose Francisco "Kiko" Benitez
segments.text: And the timeline is supposed to be by December this year.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Unless our Senate President or anyone would like to, perhaps, I don't want to preempt the Senate President's motion.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: To deem the, I mean, to submit for plenary consideration the…

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, it's a pleasure to submit the budget of TESDA to plenary for further discussions and approval.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: There is a motion rendered no other than the Senate President of the Republic of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: How can we object to that?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And hearing no objection, the motion is carried.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So, we, the fiscal year 2027 proposed budget of the TESDA is now hereby submitted for plenary consideration subject to the discussions and submission of requested documents by our colleagues.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Again, I'd like to take this opportunity to thank our Senate President, the hardworking Senate President who keeps on pushing us to work in the wee hours of the morning.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And I think most of my time spent here in the Senate, I think at least 70% of my day spent here in the Senate or 80% of my day.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: But we're happy to work with our Senate President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Of course, thank you, Secretary Kiko Benitez, DDG Galo, DDG Urdaneta, DDG Vidal, DDG Allan, and Directors, Provincial Directors, Regional Directors, Executive Directors, of course, our friends from COA.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa inyong lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: This budget briefing is hereby suspended. Maraming salamat po sa inyo and may God bless us all. Salamat po.
